summary: The three most important visible problems are: (1) skirt/body interpenetration around the hips and upper thighs in cross_legged, high_kick and lie_back_elbows, where legs appear to emerge through the front of the garment; (2) sleeve interpenetration at the center of the chest in hug_self, where the two sleeves merge into a single pinched mass; and (3) an abrupt change in the lifted knee and lower-leg position between run frames 8 and 9, clearest in the 3/4 view. The lack of cloth and hair physics explains much of the stiff skirt silhouette and missing drape in seated or raised-leg poses, but does not remove the visible garment/body intersections. Most other poses preserve readable anatomy without obvious stretching or joint collapse. Temporal judgments are limited to the supplied samples; no item shows clear evidence of an explosion, torn mesh or reversed joint warranting a broken rating.

items.name: sit_chair
items.location: Upper thighs and front skirt panel, especially in the 3/4 view
items.issue: The skirt remains a stiff bell around the seated hips and meets the exposed thighs with an abrupt intersection-like boundary; missing seated drape is partly expected without physics.

items.name: seiza
items.issue: The front skirt and petticoat surround the folded knees as a rigid open shell instead of settling over them, with small apparent intersections at the knee edges that are partly attributable to disabled physics.

items.name: kneel_one
items.location: Raised thigh where it meets the front of the skirt
items.issue: The raised thigh visibly emerges through the skirt panel above the hem rather than lifting the fabric, a clear body/cloth intersection despite the expected lack of simulated drape.

items.name: cross_legged
items.location: Both thighs, crossed shins and central skirt panel
items.issue: The crossed legs and shoes sit through the front of the largely unchanged skirt, creating conspicuous garment/body intersections rather than cloth wrapping around the folded legs.

items.name: deep_lunge
items.location: Forward upper thigh and front skirt
items.issue: The forward thigh cuts out through the skirt surface well above its hem while the skirt retains its bell shape, making the missing cloth clearance clearly visible.

items.name: run_l
items.location: Lifted thigh and adjacent skirt underside
items.issue: The lifted thigh crowds the stiff skirt underside with a small apparent overlap near the hip, although the leg itself retains a plausible silhouette and the missing cloth response is expected without physics.

items.name: run_r
items.issue: The lifted thigh meets the skirt and petticoat with a tight, slightly intersecting boundary instead of a natural displaced fold, consistent with limited cloth response in this preview.

items.name: jump_tuck
items.issue: The skirt forms a broad rigid shelf over the tucked legs and shows cramped contact around the knees, but much of this unnatural drape is expected with physics disabled.

items.name: high_kick
items.location: Raised hip and thigh at the front of the skirt
items.issue: The kicking leg passes directly through the front skirt panel at hip height while the garment remains hanging below it, producing an unmistakable cloth/body intersection.

items.name: arms_crossed
items.location: Overlapping sleeves across the lower chest
items.issue: The inflated sleeves press together with little compression or a distinct overlap boundary, slightly merging the forearm silhouettes.

items.name: hug_self
items.location: Crossed sleeves at the center of the chest
items.issue: The two sleeves visibly merge into a single pointed, pinched mass across the chest rather than retaining separate overlapping cloth volumes.

items.name: twist_bend
items.issue: The bent and twisted waist compresses the bodice lacing into a crowded angular patch, creating a small visible pinch without clear torso collapse.

items.name: lie_back_elbows
items.location: Both upper thighs and front skirt panel
items.issue: Both extended thighs emerge through the front of the skirt while it keeps a downward bell silhouette, producing obvious garment/body intersections that missing physics only partly explains.

items.name: dance_heart
items.location: Hands against the crown and fringe
items.issue: The fingers crowd into the crown and fringe with a small apparent hair intersection where the hands meet above the forehead.

items.name: run
items.location: Lifted knee, shin and shoe, clearest in the 3/4 view
items.issue: The lifted leg changes from a strongly raised bent-knee position at frame 8 to a much straighter lowered position at frame 9, a conspicuous one-frame displacement suggesting a motion pop.

items.name: turn
items.location: Overlapping ankles and shoes near the end of the turn
items.issue: The ankles and shoes crowd into a tightly overlapping silhouette during the pivot, with slight apparent interpenetration in the 3/4 view but no clear joint reversal.

items.name: sit_stand
items.location: Front skirt, upper thighs and petticoat during sitting and rising
items.issue: The skirt remains a stiff shell around the bent thighs and develops abrupt thigh/cloth boundaries as the character sits and rises, largely consistent with disabled cloth physics rather than obvious body deformation.

items.name: spin
items.issue: The crossed feet become tightly superimposed with small apparent ankle/shoe intersections, while the flared skirt remains coherent for a preview without physics.

items.name: idol_dance
items.issue: The raised-leg beat produces a stiff flared skirt with slight apparent thigh/underskirt intersection, but the adjacent frames remain visually consistent and the limited drape is expected without physics.
